thread:
jules: Quick heads-up, opened PR to tidy Dedicated provisioning docs: cooldown/burst defaults, tiny tenant manifest example, new SDK snippet, and two link fixes. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4321
raya: I'll review this afternoon. Can you list the concrete checklist items?
jules: 1) clarify cooldown vs burst behavior with one-line example; 2) add tenant labels YAML + note about eviction preference; 3) replace deprecated JS SDK sample with unified SDK pattern; 4) fix handbook anchors flagged by link-bot; 5) add approved SLA sentence from product/legal.
link-bot: Link check -> /handbook/reserved-pools#eviction (404). Suggested replacement: https://handbook.redwood.ai/reserved-pools#eviction-behavior
sasha: I'll paste the runbook anchor and double-check other anchors.
mike: SLA approved wording: "We aim for 99.9% uptime on Dedicated capacity. Latency is covered by model-class SLOs in the SLA matrix; we do not guarantee hard latency bounds." Please include exact phrasing.
jules: SDK snippet (short unified pattern) to add:

```js
import Redwood from '@redwoodhq/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
await client.dedicated.createScalePolicy({ tenantId: 'tenant-123', policy: { minGPUs:1, maxGPUs:8, cooldownSeconds:300, burstWindowSeconds:60 } })
```

raya: I'll paste that and add the YAML isolation snippet:

```yaml
# tenant manifest
tenant_id: tenant-123
labels:
  isolation: dedicated
  env: prod
# eviction_preference: prefer-non-isolated
```

sasha: Minor edit: add one sentence that labels are indexed for routing/placement.
jules: Also adding two bullets for "exceeding quota": automatic fallback to compatible smaller model (if enabled), and queued requests with Retry-After when fallback not available. Raya will run link-check locally before merging.
raya: Plan: update PR with snippets + anchor fix + SLA sentence by EOD, request reviews from @sasha (links), @mike (SLA), @docs (final copy). Ping if blockers.
